question_cn: 国际象棋中的「中心」具体指哪四个格子？
question_en: Which four squares make up the center of the chessboard?
explanation_cn: 中心格是棋盘正中的四个格子：e4、e5、d4、d5。控制这四个格子是开局最核心的目标，因为占据中心的棋子对全盘影响力最大。
explanation_en: The center consists of the four squares in the middle of the board: e4, e5, d4, and d5. Controlling them is a key opening goal because pieces occupying the center influence the whole board.
